name: Falling For The Cold Prince On My Roof
source:
Wishes do come true! When the cold prince falls on your roof,
will you thaw his heart or will you be left out to freeze?

[Edited from [url=https://froggikit.itch.io/falling-for-the-cold-prince-on-my-roof-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
愿望真的会实现！当冷酷的王子掉落在你家屋顶上时，
你会融化他的心，还是会被晾在一旁冻僵呢？

[整编自[url=https://froggikit.itch.io/falling-for-the-cold-prince-on-my-roof-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
